Every line divides by 2.5% a year of inflation, so the values are in the purchasing power of the start. After 25 years the 0.5% fee line ends $46,589 ahead in today’s money. Fees deducted over the period come to $13,745 at 0.5% and $47,840 at 2% in today’s dollars. The gap is larger than the difference in fees because the deducted amounts would also have grown. The no-fee line is a reference, not an available product.
